تدعون (form I)
# تَدُعُّونَ (taduʕʕūna) /ta.duʕ.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of دَعَّ (daʕʕa)
# تُدَعُّونَ (tudaʕʕūna) /tu.daʕ.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of دَعَّ (daʕʕa)
